tool.name: Macro Intelligence
tool.question: What macro regime are markets in, and what is driving it?

public_api.key_issuance: Sign in with Google at https://macro.aribresearch.com/account and create up to 3 keys. Keys are shown once and cannot be recovered later. They do not expire; revoke them on the same page.

endpoints.summary: Current macro regime, Macro Score (0-100), coverage, agreement, drivers, key changes
